facts.business: PVR INOX Limited operates movie exhibition multiplexes in India and Sri Lanka, and engages in movie production and distribution through its subsidiary PVR INOX Pictures Limited.

segments.name: Others (includes bowling, gaming and restaurant services etc.)

guidance_or_targets.statement: Focus remains unchanged - to create experiences that make every outing memorable
guidance_or_targets.value: Create experiences that make every outing memorable

key_risks: Content Risk - theatrical content pipeline gaps or underperformance
Competitive Risk (OTT) - competition from streaming platforms
Macroeconomic & Discretionary Spending Risk - sensitivity to economic cycles, inflation, and income levels
Window & Piracy Risk - perceived shortening of theatrical release windows
Financial Risks (Interest Rate, Currency, Liquidity, Credit)
Regulatory & Compliance Risk - operating across 24 states and UTs with distinct regulatory requirements
facts.related_party_note: Transactions with the related parties are in compliance with sections 177 and 188 of Companies Act, 2013 where applicable and the details have been disclosed in the notes to the standalone financial statements, as required by the applicable accounting standards.
